verdict.rationale: Cognee documents some autonomous-feeling integrations — an installable Linear agent that automatically answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory, and GitHub org indexing that keeps a code graph updated — which imply background/event-driven automation, but there is no documented scheduler, workflow/automation builder, or explicit 'runs autonomously in background' job system. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron or automation-pipeline feature, independent confirmation that these integrations run unattended long-term, broader coverage beyond Linear/GitHub examples.
